items.text: PHP discloses a critical memory-management vulnerability, dubbed “PHP2Shell”, that affects up to 70% of websites, discovered using GPT-5.6 Sol in August. AI tools helped find one of the most severe online bugs ever. Cyber experts are racing to patch it before hackers use AI to exploit it.

items.title: Battle Drones - a vibe coded RTS with audio-based multiplayer
items.text: My latest vibe coded game experiment is a Command & Conquer style RTS (Real Time Strategy) game called Battle Drones ( play it here ). Unlike my previous experiments , this one is actually fun to play . I'm somewhat embarrassed to admit that I got there by telling Claude to "Make it a LOT more fun". It also supports multiplayer between nearby devices using audio to synchronize game state! Here's what I've built so far, and some of the things I learned along the way.

items.title: OpenAI says it will make its AI models available on Google Cloud's model garden and Antigravity cod…
items.text: OpenAI says it will make its AI models available on Google Cloud's model garden and Antigravity coding tool in the coming weeks, after launching on AWS in April. OpenAI will make its artificial intelligence models available for developers through Google's cloud, following years of competition between the two companies.

items.text: OpenAI expands ChatGPT ads to 26 additional countries, taking the total to 83 countries, and says the platform's advertiser base is 100K+, up from 20K in August. OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT ads to 26 more countries as it tries to turn advertising into a bigger source of revenue to help cover its AI costs.
